mapper.select: select a.Y_M as yM,a.REGION as region,a.ORG_ID as orgId,a.ORG_NAME as orgName, sum(a.YJ_WX_NUM) as yjWxNum, sum(a.SJ_WX_NUM) as sjWxNum, sum(a.YJ_WX_TOTAL) as yjWxTotal, sum(a.SJ_WX_TOTAL) as sjWxTotal, sum(a.YJ_GJJ_NUM) as yjGjjNum, sum(a.SJ_GJJ_NUM) as sjGjjNum, sum(a.YJ_GJJ_TOTAL) as yjGjjTotal, sum(a.SJ_GJJ_TOTAL) as sjGjjTotal from SUB_FUND a ${ew.customSqlSegment} group by a.Y_M,a.REGION,a.ORG_ID,a.ORG_NAME
select a.REGION as region,a.ORG_ID as orgId,a.ORG_NAME as orgName,a.Y_M as flwYM, b.* from SUB_FUND a join SUB_FUND_ITEM b on a.ID = b.SUB_FUND_ID ${ew.customSqlSegment}
